_doc: Registered cluster identities (E1.7(b), SS N-119): the non-secret identity stamped into every census head as `db_identity` (database name + domain-tagged sha256 of pg_control_system().system_identifier; never a host, user, password or URL). A census whose db_identity equals a registered entry's was read from that cluster. Registration evidence is TWO INDEPENDENT READS of one value by two sessions through their approved read-only reader helpers. Append-only by convention: a restored/cloned cluster has a different identity and needs its own entry.
